children: Canada construction firm's Q3 revenue rose 36.7% yr/yr on broad-based organic growth
Adjusted EPS for Q3 beat analyst expectations
Adjusted EBITDA for Q3 beat analyst expectations
Bird says record C$13.0 bln backlog and pending backlog provide visibility into future growth
Company says it is confident in achieving its 2027 Strategic Plan goals
Bird expects continued growth supported by diversified opportunities across key sectors
ORGANIC GROWTH - Nearly 90% of Q3 revenue growth was organic, driven by strong execution across Industrial, Buildings and Infrastructure businesses
MARGIN EXPANSION - Improved gross profit percentage and adjusted EBITDA margin contributed to earnings growth
LEGAL CLAIM RESOLUTION - Adjusted EBITDA margin benefited from favourable resolution of a historical construction-related legal claim
The current average analyst rating on the shares is "buy" and the breakdown of recommendations is 7 "strong buy" or "buy", 1 "hold" and no "sell" or "strong sell"
The average consensus recommendation for the construction & engineering peer group is "buy"
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Bird Construction Inc. is C$87.00, about 19.5% above its November 10 closing price of C$72.80
The stock recently traded at 20 times the next 12-month earnings vs. a P/E of 21 three months ago
